name: Chubb Limited
summary: Chubb Limited provides insurance and reinsurance products worldwide. It operates in six segments: North America Commercial Property and Casualty (P&C) Insurance, North America Personal P&C Insurance, North America Agricultural Insurance, Overseas General Insurance, Global Reinsurance, and Life Insurance. The company offers property and general liability, workers' compensation, and umbrella; profes
verdict: Einstufung: Qualität (Buffett-Typ) – erfüllt 5/7 Buffett-Kriterien – stabiler, profitabler Burggraben. Buffett-Score 71/100 (Interessant), Innovations-Score 21/100 (Noch zu früh/zu teuer). Geschätzter fairer Wert ≈ 456.48 USD (+22 % zum Kurs). Risiko: Niedrig.
